description: This file defines a class MeetingCalendarSyncLogicHook that implements afterSave and afterDelete hooks to synchronize meeting data with an external calendar system via the CalendarSync class.

classes.name: MeetingCalendarSyncLogicHook
classes.description: A class implementing logic hooks for meeting record save and delete events to trigger calendar synchronization.

methods.name: afterSave
methods.description: Handles post-save actions for a Meeting bean, triggering calendar synchronization.

methods.name: afterDelete
methods.description: Handles post-delete actions for a Meeting bean, triggering calendar synchronization.
